questionFlaws.V141: Ambiguous referent: "the researchers" has no antecedent, so the question cannot single out the cross-validation study its expected answer comes from. The v2 self-reference filter caught "the authors" and "this paper" but not this. Graded in the model favour in ALL THREE arms.
questionFlaws.V207: Underdetermined: asks for "a common technique" against excessive complexity, and early stopping and regularization are equally valid corpus-grounded answers to that. The expected answer names dropout, but nothing in the question selects it. Graded in the model favour in ALL THREE arms.
questionFlaws.V192: Unverifiable negative: the expected answer asserts the corpus has no CrystalFlow code-availability information, but that was inferred from one source window. All three arms cite a chunk giving the GitHub URL, Zenodo and the MIT licence. A negative expected answer cannot be checked against a corpus the generator saw only a slice of. Graded in the model favour in ALL THREE arms.
